body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one space within 3 units. Prepare a simple hazard there until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Increase one range, Defense penalty, or trigger distance from this card by 1.
If this card establishes a Contingency, it may trigger one additional time before expiring. This Surge may be used only once.

rider.title: TRAP CONTINGENCY
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Contingency. Trigger: An enemy enters the prepared space. Effect: It burns 1 die on its next Action.
rider.meta: EXPIRES: START OF YOUR NEXT TURN
